desc: An all new parallax free, Hard Dip Coated - Acrylic optic, which can withstand up to ten times greater shock impact than products using regular glass lenes. Unlike many competing products, the RMSd is designed without a red reflective filter on the lens to ensure minimal visual signature. The sight body is made from aerospace-grade aluminum and has an anodized matte black finish. Variable intensity drive circuit that senses target light levels and controls LED output giving optimum visibility of the dot against the target. The RMSd fits all mounts readily available for the SMS. The RMSd has side accessible battery drawer that allows you to change the battery without having to unmount the sight. The Glass Edition has an all new scratch-resistant ultra clear Glass Lens, and upgraded electronics with improved battery contacts with the same frame and low-profile that allows you to co-witness with standard iron sights.
